name: Mitten Extracts | 5g Moonrocks | Super Nurdz
description: Bursting with vibrant candy sweetness, Super Nurdz Moon Rocks offer bold fruity flavor with a playful twist. Infused flower wrapped in concentrate and finished with a kief coating delivers a potent, full-bodied smoke that’s rich from start to finish.
